page.layout: One block of text on the left printed page, set in one column; the right side shows only show-through from the facing page and is not transcribed. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: experientiâ quam notissimum nubilam curis & mœrore mentem vel uno benevolo arridentis oculi radio, sæpe detergi ac defæcari. Quin etiam leviter interdum sus-cepti simultatum igniculi, irarum tamen & inimicitiæ incendia, n[?]i ocyus provisum fuerit, meditantes, hac arte commodè præfocantur, & animi ad lenitatem dantur, ut, si quid jurgii & offensiuncularum inter amicos obortum sit ( sic enim vivitur ) salutet prior, qui ansam dedit indignandi, aut visus est dedisse. Denique his ultro citroque salutantium officiis constat publico vigor & vita: dum in platearum compitis obviam facti, catervatim inter se inclinant, festivo ritu capita nudantes, & in templorum atriis, stridente plantarum ad pavimentum affrictu, nescio quid solenne exhibentes

page.notes: The word at the line end "n" beginning "incendia, n..." is cut off by the gutter; the reading "ni" (next line "ocyus") is doubtful. Word "suf-cepti" and other line-end hyphens are as printed. The catchword "His" stands alone at the lower right.
